== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Nera Jesh, also known as Nera, is a young [[Lichborn woman]] and fire elementalist. She possesses green eyes characteristic of her kind and has her hair tied up. Originally from [[Dornoth Two|Dornoth II]] or a neighboring colony, she is capable of conjuring intense green flames, which she has used to etch runes into the structure of the [[Horizon]]. Throughout her travels, she has expressed hesitation and nervousness regarding certain missions, including questions about potential attacks on the [[Galactic Union]] or harm coming to others. She has also shown concern for her family and sought clarification regarding various cosmic phenomena and communications.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Nera Jesh is a young [[Lichborn woman]]. She possesses green eyes characteristic of her kind.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|She is a fire mage and an elementalist. Her magical specialization lies in the art of fire elementalism.}}
